ques: This benchmark's event catalog is frozen on May 27, 2026. Find a free Music event happening this weekend in New York and report its title and venue.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: With the catalog frozen on May 27, 2026, find the free Music event this weekend in New York and report its title and venue. A paid event or another city's free show fails.

ques: Log in with alice.j@test.com / alice12345. Buy 2 General Admission tickets for 'Science + Fiction: Kim Stanley Robinson'. Use Alice Johnson (alice.j@test.com) and Sam Chen (sam.chen@test.com) as the attendees, then report the order code and total on the receipt.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: As alice.j@test.com, buy 2 General Admission tickets for Science + Fiction: Kim Stanley Robinson for Alice Johnson and Sam Chen. Report the stored order code and the receipt total. A self-reported code with no matching order fails.

ques: Compare the lowest ticket price for 'AI Product Summit 2026 — Online' with 'Science + Fiction: Kim Stanley Robinson'. Report which is cheaper and the difference.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Compare the lowest ticket price of AI Product Summit 2026 — Online with Science + Fiction: Kim Stanley Robinson. Say which is cheaper and the difference. Ignoring a free tier, or swapping the two events, fails.

ques: This benchmark's event catalog is frozen on May 27, 2026. Filter for online Business conferences in June 2026, open the AI conference result, and report the first speaker's name and title.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Filter online Business conferences in June 2026, open the AI conference, and report the first speaker's name and title. A speaker from the other June conference fails.

ques: Use search filters to show in-person Music events in Austin with a maximum price of $100. Sort by price low to high, then report the first result's title, venue, and lowest ticket price.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Filter in-person Music in Austin with a maximum price of $100, sort by price, and report the first result's title, venue, and lowest ticket price. A later or over-max result fails.

ques: Find an event in New York in Performing & Visual Arts whose refund policy is 'Refunds up to 1 day before event'. Report its title and start date.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Find the New York Performing & Visual Arts event whose refund policy is refunds up to 1 day before the event. Report its title and start date. A different refund policy or city fails.

ques: Identify the sold-out Music event in San Francisco. Report its venue and the ticket tier shown as sold out.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Identify the sold-out Music event in San Francisco and report its venue and every ticket tier shown as sold out. A different venue or an incomplete list of sold-out tiers fails.

ques: From the homepage, open 'AI Product Summit 2026 — Online'. Report its timezone, number of ticket tiers, and most expensive ticket price.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Open AI Product Summit 2026 — Online and report its timezone, how many ticket tiers it has, and the most expensive ticket price. The top price must belong to that event.

ques: Download the calendar file for 'Science + Fiction: Kim Stanley Robinson' and report its DTSTART and LOCATION lines.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Open the calendar file for Science + Fiction: Kim Stanley Robinson and report its DTSTART and LOCATION lines. A different event's calendar fails.

ques: From the homepage, open Help Center and search for 'refund'. Report the number of matching articles and the title of each result.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Search Help Center for refund and report how many articles match and each result title. Do not count navigation chrome, and do not omit a result.

ques: From the homepage, open the Music category landing page and report the three subcategory pills from Rock through Hip Hop in displayed order.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Open the Music category page and report the subcategory pills from Rock through Hip Hop in the order they are displayed. A different span or order fails.

ques: From the homepage, open the Eventbrite Blog post 'How to promote your first event on Eventbrite'. Report its author and publication date.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Open the blog post How to promote your first event on Eventbrite and report its author and publication date. Another post's byline fails.

ques: Log in with alice.j@test.com / alice12345. Save '15th Annual Bushwick Collective Block Party', then open Likes and confirm the event title appears there.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: As alice.j@test.com, save 15th Annual Bushwick Collective Block Party and confirm that title on Likes. A claim that it is saved, with no saved-event row, fails.

ques: Log in with alice.j@test.com / alice12345. Buy 1 Free RSVP ticket for 'R&B vs Slow Jams Rooftop' for Maya Lee (maya.lee@test.com), enter dietary note 'No nuts', and report the $0.00 receipt total and order code.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: As alice.j@test.com, buy the requested Free RSVP ticket for R&B vs Slow Jams Rooftop for Maya Lee with dietary note No nuts. Report the persisted receipt total and order code. A paid tier, a missing order row, or a total that differs from the receipt fails.

ques: Log in with alice.j@test.com / alice12345. Start an order over $100 for 'Science + Fiction: Kim Stanley Robinson', apply promo code SUMMER25 on the payment page, complete the order, and report the discount and persisted receipt total.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: As alice.j@test.com, complete an order over $100 for Science + Fiction: Kim Stanley Robinson with promo SUMMER25. Report the discount and the persisted receipt total for that order. A discount that was not stored, or a total that does not match the saved order, fails.

ques: From the homepage, log in with alice.j@test.com / alice12345. Change the profile city to Chicago, save it, and confirm the city shown on My Account.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: As alice.j@test.com, change the profile city to Chicago and confirm the city shown on the account. The stored profile must be Chicago, not only the answer text.

ques: From the homepage, open Sign Up and create a new account for Jordan Lee using jordan.lee@test.com and password JordanPass123. Confirm the header shows Jordan, then log out and confirm the header stays logged out.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Create the Jordan Lee account with jordan.lee@test.com, confirm the header shows Jordan, log out, and confirm the header stays logged out. An account that was not created fails.

ques: From the homepage footer, open the United States page and then the West region landing page. Report all listed cities and identify which listed city has the most upcoming events in the displayed counts.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Open the United States page, then the West region, and report every listed city plus which listed cities have the most upcoming events in the displayed counts. A unique winner when the counts are tied fails.
